store_size.note: each tx dir is a preallocated 256 MiB log + 1 MiB checkpoint file

offline_dump.requires: Community: neo4j-admin database dump runs only against an offline DBMS; STOP DATABASE is Enterprise-only, so the neo4j container must be stopped
offline_dump.image: neo4j:2026.04.0 (local, 1.04GB, same version as the server; no pull)
offline_dump.destination: /Users/isaac1/Documents/GitHub/terraform_gcp_search/backups/neo4j/<UTC stamp>/ (git-ignored by .gitignore:42 backups/); host bind mount, NOT inside the Docker volume (would grow the sparse Docker.raw)
offline_dump.expected_size: store 146 MB + system 1.3 MB; with tx logs <=416 MB uncompressed input; compressed archive estimated ~40-150 MB (compressibility measurement was denied)
offline_dump.expected_duration: stop 3-10 s + dump neo4j 10-20 s + dump system ~5 s + start ~9 s (measured 2026-10-09: container start 01:17:54 -> Started 01:18:03) = ~1 min; budget 5 min
offline_dump.impact: KG-backed features (chat graph tools, scholar lookups, map People/Places) error during the window; search, /health and the watchdog unaffected (/health is static)
runbook: docker stop -t 120 genizah_search-neo4j-1   # graceful checkpoint; default 10 s timeout is too tight; avoid compose (dependency handling, accidental recreate)
docker run --rm --user 7474:7474 -v genizah_search_neo4j_data:/data -v "$DEST":/backups neo4j:2026.04.0 neo4j-admin database dump neo4j --to-path=/backups --verbose
docker run --rm --user 7474:7474 -v genizah_search_neo4j_data:/data -v "$DEST":/backups neo4j:2026.04.0 neo4j-admin database dump system --to-path=/backups
docker start genizah_search-neo4j-1   # never compose up
verify counts, SHOW INDEXES all ONLINE, one KG endpoint on :8000
docker run --rm -v "$DEST":/backups neo4j:2026.04.0 neo4j-admin database load --info --from-path=/backups neo4j
shasum -a 256 "$DEST"/*.dump; rm the MAINTENANCE file; copy off-machine
restore_in_place: dump the current state first (same commands, new $DEST) as an undo point
docker run --rm --user 7474:7474 -v genizah_search_neo4j_data:/data -v "$DEST":/backups neo4j:2026.04.0 neo4j-admin database load neo4j --from-path=/backups --overwrite-destination=true
docker start genizah_search-neo4j-1; verify counts/indexes; rm MAINTENANCE
system DB normally left alone (keeps users); load system.dump only to restore auth
offline_dump.restore_rehearsal: docker volume create neo4j_restore_check; load into it; run a throwaway neo4j:2026.04.0 on 127.0.0.1:7691 with its own NEO4J_AUTH; compare counts; remove (needs approval)
offline_dump.version_rule: load with the same or a newer Neo4j; Neo4j Desktop's cached Enterprise 2025.10.1 is older and cannot load it (general upgrade policy; the dump/load pages do not state it)

format.manifest.json: time, version, counts before/after, constraint + index createStatements

full_estimate.time_s: ~9 (3.8 node reads + 3.6 rel reads + 1.9 serialize/gzip); budget <1 min; no downtime

logical_export.restore: kg_restore_outline.py: empty target only; constraints/indexes from manifest first (skip LOOKUP); nodes grouped by label via batched UNWIND CREATE returning elementId into a Python id map; rels grouped by type through NodeByElementIdSeek (EXPLAIN-verified on prod); verify counts; not executed
caveats: read-committed isolation, not a snapshot: run with writers paused and compare counts before/after (the store has been write-idle since 2026-09-18)
does not carry users/roles or internal ids; new elementIds after restore
the helper run() materializes rows; a full export should stream (per label/type) to cap memory
